about: Gravity fits applied to assets/urdf/marengo.urdf, read by the marengo-pi-mcp τ guard (tools/marengo-pi-mcp/src/tau-factor.ts). A listed joint uses factor 1 + max(3σ_A/A, 0.15) while the Pi URDF has urdf_gravity_sha256 (npm run gravity-fingerprint in tools/marengo-pi-mcp) and the record's fitted COMs; otherwise 1.6.
